Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: In Step 2, the WebSurfer agent made a critical factual error by hallucinating that the search query was looking for the "Wikimedia Foundation" instead of the "Free Software Foundation." The agent's internal monologue explicitly states: "...to verify the foundation behind the Free Software Directory (the Wikimedia Foundation, founded by Jimmy Wales in 2003)." This is a complete fabrication; the search query was clearly for the Free Software Foundation (FSF), and the results displayed on the screen were entirely about the FSF and Richard Stallman. By introducing this incorrect entity (Wikimedia Foundation) into its reasoning, the agent created confusion and deviated from the task, even though the visible search results correctly identified Richard Stallman as the founder of the FSF. This type of hallucination regarding the subject of the search is a severe error in information retrieval.
